notes.title: Patch Notes - February 9, 2017
notes.notes:
A new patch is available for Danger Room! Test conditions have been drastically altered, challenging test subjects to survive in even more treacherous conditions. Game performance has also been greatly optimised, fixing any stuttering that might have been occurring. A ton of bugs and visual glitches have also been fixed. We hope you enjoy the latest version of Danger Room!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[b]- Drastically increased difficulty curve for all game modes[/b]

Turrets spawn and react a lot faster, resulting in much more challenging gameplay. Score multipliers have been adjusted accordingly.

[b]- Tons of performance optimisations

- Fixed bugs with UI and visual glitches[/b]
